newsitem.title: USA: Unify sees Q3 pretax loss of $8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Unify sees Q3 pretax loss of $8 mln.

text.p: Unify Corp said Thursday its third fiscal quarter results will be significantly below expectations and it expects to report a pretax loss for the third quarter of about $8 million.
The company also said in a statement that based on revenue estimates it does not expect to record any tax benefit on the loss.
Analysts had expected the company would post a loss of $0.06 a share, according to First Call. The company declined to give a current estimate for earnings per share.
Unify estimated total revenues will be about $2.5 million.

The total includes about $2.8 million of software license revenue as well as $2.5 million of services revenue augmented by a reversal of $2.8 million in revenue recognized in the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
That reversal comes from a large China contract, the payments for which are in default.

The company estimated operating expenses of about $10.5 million, including non-recurring charges of about $1 million of bad debt expense related to a separate large China contract, as well as other one-time charges of about $1.2 million. Unify said it will report results of third quarter operations after the stock market closes on February 18.
